Section 5: Experience, Continued Use and Sustainability of the Previous Afya-Tek Model
Rate each statement: 1 = Strongly disagree, 2 = Disagree, 3 = Neutral, 4 = Agree, 5 = Strongly agree.

Rate each statement: 1 = Strongly disagree, 2 = Disagree, 3 = Neutral, 4 = Agree, 5 = Strongly agree.

High workload may limit the execution of CPP referrals.
Limited digital skills among healthcare workers may hinder execution of CPP referrals.
Inadequate access to smartphones, tablets, or computers may hinder execution of CPP referrals.
Poor internet connectivity may hinder execution of CPP referrals.
Unreliable electricity supply may hinder execution of CPP referrals.
Inadequate training may hinder execution of CPP referrals.
